shell.about.intro: This workspace turns NASA and ISRO NISAR L-band radar scenes, together with public data, into a shortlist of where to look first after a coastal hazard. It is a first look, not a survey: every class is named "likely", it is not a warning, and it is not a flooded area in km². Values tagged Sample values are placeholders until the real products replace them.
